title: Vanessa Bryant Attends Bad Bunny World Tour Concert, As He Pays Tribute To Lakers Legend Kobe Bryant
htmlContent:
Most people understand that loosing someone who is near and dear to us can cause all sorts of depressions. Most people who have experience the death of a partner/spouse. All can relate to the term “a part of me died when they did”. Vanessa Bryant lost Kobe “Bean” Bryant tragically. Not only was he her husband of 19 years, he was a basketball Icon around the world!

The beloved widow also lost her precious daughter Gianna “GiGi” Bryant. Both during a unfortunate accident on the morning of Jan 26, 2020 On Saturday (Oct. 1), Bad Bunny met with Vanessa Bryant backstage at his concert in Inglewood, CA. Bad bunny has always been a life long Kobe fan!

The Puerto Rican phenomenon has been paying tribute ever since Kobe’s death. He invited Vanessa and extended the invitation to whoever she wanted to bring. Benito released a tribute song “6 Rings” on SoundCloud. The song title was a reference to Kobe’s NBA championship rings as well as his wedding ring. “Congratulations, you too won six rings! Five in the NBA and one in the marriage!

During the concert Bad Bunny wore a very special bracelet. A bracelet Vanessa had gifted back in 2020 to close friends during a ceremony which would have been GiGi’s 14th birthday. Vanessa was also wearing a bracelet that honored her beloved late daughter. It read “Mambacita”.

From the looks of it, Vanessa enjoyed the show accompanied by a close female friend and a few bodyguards who shielded her for privacy. Her life has drastically changed over the past 2 years, something no one can imagine. So a night out was something well overdue and needed! She took to IG to show her gratitude and appreciation for Bad Bunny invitation.
